title: Nechemyah of Beit Deli

paragraphs: Nechemyah of Beit Deli. (A Babylonian Tanna, a student of Rabban Gamliel the Elder.) Mishnah Yevamot, chapter 16, mentions him. Rabbi Akiva says: “When I went down to Nehardea to intercalate the year, I found Nechemyah of Beit Deli. He said to me: ‘I have heard that in the Land of Israel no one permits a woman to remarry on one witness’s testimony except Rabbi Yehudah ben Bava. Tell them in my name: This is my received tradition from Rabban Gamliel the Elder,’” etc.
So too it is brought in Eduyot ch. 8, mishnah 5: Rabbi Akiva testified in his name that a woman may be permitted to remarry on the testimony of a single witness.
